title: Quick Grilled Slovakian Sauerkraut Skewers
description: A fresh and light Slovakian dish featuring sauerkraut, perfect for a cozy meal, grilled to perfection on a yakimono grill, and keto friendly.

ingredients.name: mushrooms
ingredients.notes: button mushrooms, cut into 1 inch pieces

instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, mix together the sauerkraut, pork sausage, onion, bell pepper, mushrooms, and garlic.
Thread the mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the sausage is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving.
